result:
Both deliverables are written and verified:

**`outputs/runs/single/proposal.docx`** (20 KB) — Customer-facing branded proposal covering executive summary, full technical proposal (workload coverage, scale, multi-region/data-residency architecture, competitive positioning vs. Databricks/Snowflake/Fabric), 5-year commercial proposal at 30% strategic discount off Enterprise list ($594K → $722K/yr with 99.99% SLA premium), implementation timeline (26 weeks to full Teradata migration), three customer references, and a proactive legal position table flagging all RFP blockers with counter-positions.

**`outputs/runs/single/risk-assessment.html`** (26 KB) — Fully self-contained interactive internal risk dashboard with: animated SVG gauge (net risk 8.25%, amber zone → "Escalate to VP"), revenue attractiveness bar (100/100), 12 clause toggle cards (5 BLOCKERs: uncapped liability, reg fines, IP assignment, instant SLA termination, MFN), expandable counter-position text per card, live risk recalculation on toggle, and "Show worst-case / Reset to proposed" buttons.
